detail.title: No-go: skew Koszul deformations do not create the W114 primitive class
detail.description:
Compass-generated negative family.

Start from Q=f^T g with three pair factorizations and deform
F=f+Sg, S^T=-S,
so F^T g=Q identically.

A concrete degree-(113,1) construction with
h=x1^7*x3^42*x5^63
was designed so an individual Jacobian-determinant term lands at the W114 target exponent (0,6,77,78,85,90). Exact finite-field coefficient extraction mod 457 (rho of order 228) found four target-contributing determinant terms whose signed sum is exactly zero.

Structural explanation to formalize:
in the wedge dF_1∧dg_1∧...∧dF_3∧dg_3, the S-dependent terms reduce to contributions containing dQ (plus repeated df_i/dg_i terms); in Jac(Q), dQ=0. Therefore these skew/gauge deformations cannot change the primitive Favero–Kelly class.

Status: strong derived lemma + exact counterprobe; needs a clean symbolic proof before promotion to general no-go.

Compost value:
visible deformation can preserve Q yet be cohomologically gauge-trivial. Future MF/CI generators must change the K-class/Jacobian image, not only the presentation.
